::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** the 2d of June,  1893  
**From:** Leipzig,  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA collection 100 box 119
:::

My dear Miss Yonge,
If I am not mistaken, you have issued lately several books. Do you not think that there is one that would be suitable for republication in our [Series](organizations/other_224.qmd)? If so, we should be glad to receive a copy, in order to judge how best to arrange our edition.

I sincerely wish that you may enjoy your usual good health and, hoping to receive your kind reply at your earliest convenience, I beg [you] to believe me,

with [my father’](people/person_1396.qmd)s and my own best regards to you,
Yours very sincerely
[Tauchnitz](people/person_2124.qmd)
